responsibility: Implements forward copy propagation on hard registers after allocation/reload. It tracks equivalence classes of hard registers across RTL, substitutes older equivalent hard-register values into later insns and addresses when constraints and mode changes allow, updates or defers debug-insn substitutions safely, and cleans up trivial reload-era register shuffling to reduce dependencies and improve later scheduling freedom. This pass works on hard-register values rather than pseudo-register SSA-like propagation.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file implements the full hard-register copy-propagation pass, including value tracking, debug-insn deferral/update logic, CFG traversal, and pass registration. The companion header gcc/regcprop.h only exposes a narrow helper for running block-local propagation without debug-insn handling.
